52.DOS攻击防范（自动屏蔽攻击IP）
 
53.目录入侵检测与告警
 
#!/bin/bash
 
DATE=$(date +%F_%T)
 
WWWROOT=/usr/local/nginx/html/$1
 
 
BACKUP_DIR=/data/backup
WORK_DIR=/tmp
PROJECT_NAME=php-demo
 
 
# 拉取代码
cd $WORK_DIR
if [ ! -d $PROJECT_NAME ]; then
   git clone https://github.com/lizhenliang/php-demo
   cd $PROJECT_NAME
else
   cd $PROJECT_NAME
   git pull
fi
 
 
# 部署
if [ ! -d $WWWROOT ]; then
   mkdir -p $WWWROOT
   rsync -avz --exclude=.git $WORK_DIR/$PROJECT_NAME/* $WWWROOT
else
   rsync -avz --exclude=.git $WORK_DIR/$PROJECT_NAME/* $WWWROOT
fi
#!/bin/bash
DATE=$(date +%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M)
#nginx日志
LOG_FILE=/usr/local/nginx/logs/demo2.access.log
#分析ip的访问情况
ABNORMAL_IP=$(tail -n5000 $LOG_FILE |grep $DATE |awk '{a[$1]++}END{for(i in 
a)if(a[i]>10)print i}')
for IP in $ABNORMAL_IP; do
    if [ $(iptables -vnL |grep -c "$IP") -eq 0 ]; then
        iptables -I INPUT -s $IP -j DROP
        echo "$(date +'%F_%T') $IP" >> /tmp/drop_ip.log
    fi
done
